title: 380 FREE Claude Code Skills You Need Right Now
description:
There are 380 free skills you can add to Claude Cowork right now. Skills are like apps you install and each one teaches Claude a new job. Companies like Google, Vercel, and Stripe contributed official ones. There’s also a pack with 148 slash commands and 54 built-in AI agents. One install and your whole Cowork setup changes overnight. Copy the file, drop it in your project, and Claude learns the new skill instantly.

🔗 Free Claude Cowork Skills: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1KYNLhXbnV0TUAopKrkb-dvi1kLDyQbXEZ_h1_AIGwgs/view
